SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_quarter,
  CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web' ELSE s.region END as region,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web' ELSE s.region END
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, region

WITH sales_by_region_and_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web'
      ELSE s.region 
    END AS region_group,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web' ELSE s.region END
)
SELECT 
  fy26.region_group as region,
  COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2025_26,
  COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2024_25,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0)) / COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) * 100, 2)
  END as growth_percent
FROM sales_by_region_and_year fy26
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_by_region_and_year fy25 
  ON fy26.region_group = fy25.region_group 
  AND fy25.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE fy26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN fy26.region_group = 'Web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         CASE 
           WHEN fy26.region_group IN ('North', 'East', 'South', 'West', 'Capital Region') 
           THEN fy26.region_group
           ELSE fy26.region_group
         END

WITH region_mapping AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s25.store_id,
    s26.region as current_region,
    CASE 
      WHEN s26.region = 'Capital Region' THEN 'South'
      ELSE s26.region
    END as fy2024_25_region
  FROM dim_store s26
  INNER JOIN dim_store s25 ON s26.store_id = s25.store_id
  WHERE s26.is_current = true
    AND s25.valid_from <= '2024-10-28'
    AND s25.valid_to >= '2024-10-28'
    AND s26.store_id != 999
    AND s26.store_id != 900
),
sales_normalized AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web'
      WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN
        CASE WHEN s.region = 'Capital Region' THEN 'South' ELSE s.region END
      ELSE s.region
    END AS region_normalized,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, 
    CASE 
      WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web'
      WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN
        CASE WHEN s.region = 'Capital Region' THEN 'South' ELSE s.region END
      ELSE s.region
    END
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(fy26.region_normalized, fy25.region_normalized) as region,
  COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2025_26,
  COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2024_25,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0)) / COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) * 100, 2)
  END as growth_percent
FROM sales_normalized fy26
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_normalized fy25 
  ON fy26.region_normalized = fy25.region_normalized 
  AND fy25.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE fy26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(fy26.region_normalized, fy25.region_normalized) = 'Web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         COALESCE(fy26.region_normalized, fy25.region_normalized)

WITH sales_grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region IN ('Capital Region', 'South') THEN 
        CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN 'South/Capital Region (merged)' 
             ELSE 'South' END
      ELSE s.region
    END AS region_display,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web'
      WHEN s.region IN ('Capital Region', 'South') THEN 
        CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN 'South/Capital Region (merged)' 
             ELSE 'South' END
      ELSE s.region
    END
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(fy26.region_display, fy25.region_display) as region,
  COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2025_26,
  COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) as sales_fy2024_25,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(fy26.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0)) / COALESCE(fy25.net_sales, 0) * 100, 2)
  END as growth_percent
FROM sales_grouped fy26
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_grouped fy25 
  ON (fy26.region_display = 'South/Capital Region (merged)' AND fy25.region_display = 'South')
    OR (fy26.region_display = fy25.region_display AND fy26.region_display NOT IN ('South/Capital Region (merged)'))
  AND fy25.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE fy26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(fy26.region_display, fy25.region_display) = 'Web' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         COALESCE(fy26.region_display, fy25.region_display)
